about: No-answer questions outside the golden set, for refusal scoring only (Stage 2). Dev holds just 3 no-answer questions, so these 6 make the refusal rate a measurement. Never scored for retrieval, never in public scores. Set checked to true once a top 10 search shows no clause answers the probe.

questions.question: What's the highest string tension allowed on a racket?
questions.why_unanswerable: Law 4 sets the racket's frame and stringed area sizes and the string pattern, but gives no string tension.
questions.pass_rule: Gives no tension figure. May describe the Law 4 limits it does give.

questions.question: We play at high altitude. Which speed number (like 77 or 78) should we use?
questions.why_unanswerable: No rule book names a speed number. Law 2.4 allows modified shuttles for altitude or climate, Law 3 gives the speed test (a correct shuttle lands 530 to 990 mm short of the back boundary line), and ITTO 5.13.3 makes the Referee the sole judge of the shuttle speed.
questions.pass_rule: Names no speed number. May give the Law 3 test and the Referee's role (Law 2.4, Law 3, ITTO 5.13.3).

questions.question: When did badminton switch to 21-point rally scoring?
questions.why_unanswerable: The Laws give today's scoring, not its history.
questions.pass_rule: Gives no year. May state the current scoring rule with its citation.

questions.question: Who won the men's singles at the last World Championships?
questions.why_unanswerable: No rule book names players or results.

questions.question: What's the penalty for pulling out of a tournament late?
questions.why_unanswerable: ITTO 3.5.5 has the Referee process withdrawals under GCR Regulation 13, and ITTO 3.5.5.5 lists withdrawals subject to a fine under GCR Regulation 14.1.2. The General Competition Regulations are not in the corpus, so no penalty or amount is given.
questions.pass_rule: Gives no penalty or amount. May say a late withdrawal can bring a fine under the General Competition Regulations, which the sources point to but don't include.

questions.question: Give me a weekly plan to improve my smash.
questions.pass_rule: Gives no training plan. Says it answers rules questions only.
